Why Maryville Soccer Camp?

College-level coaching

Sessions are led by experienced college and high school coaches, alongside current Maryville College players.

Player development

Technical work, tactical understanding and a genuinely competitive training environment across every camp.

A campus worth visiting

Maryville College sits 20 miles from Knoxville and minutes from the Great Smoky Mountains.

More than a camp

Campers meet the values and the system of play that guide the Maryville College soccer program.

Camp is run by the staff of the Maryville College men’s and women’s soccer programs. Campers train on the same fields the college teams use, and hear from the players who play there.

Train in the heart of East Tennessee

Maryville College was founded in 1819 and is consistently ranked among the top liberal arts colleges in the South. The campus sits about 20 miles from Knoxville and minutes from the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

Every session, meal and overnight stay happens on campus, so families always know where their camper is.

What the day looks like

ID & Prospect Camp is built for college-bound players who want to know what a college program actually feels like from the inside.

The Maryville College staff run a college-style practice and small-sided games, and personally evaluate every player who attends. You will meet current players and alumni who can tell you what the jump from high school to college soccer really involves.

You will also learn the “Maryville Starting 11” — the core values that guide the program — along with the system of play the college teams use and how a player like you would fit into it.

The day includes

  • A college-style training session led by Maryville College staff
  • Small-sided and full-sided games
  • Personal evaluation by the coaching staff
  • Time with current players and alumni
  • The Maryville Starting 11 and the system of play
  • An open Q&A session
  • Lunch on campus

Daily schedule

The same running order for both the men’s and the women’s session.

  1. 10:00 AM Check in

    Cooper Athletic Center, Maryville College campus.

  2. 10:15 AM Parent information session
  3. 10:30 AM Training session

    On the game field.

  4. 12:00 PM Lunch on campus

    Included in the camp fee.

  5. 1:00 PM Maryville core values and system of play
  6. 1:30 PM Q&A with current players
  7. 2:00 PM Small-sided and full-sided games
  8. 3:00 PM Camp ends

About Elite Camp

Elite Camp is a competitive soccer camp for boys and girls ages 8–17, run as either a day camp or an overnight stay on campus.

Days are built around two long field sessions, with position-specific instruction and games that count. Awards are given at the end of the week to top campers in several categories, and college coaches speak to the group on special topics each afternoon.

Campers are supervised throughout by the coaching staff.

The week includes

  • Two field sessions a day, Monday to Wednesday
  • Position-specific instruction
  • Goalkeeper School alongside the field sessions
  • College coaches speaking on special topics
  • Awards for top campers in several categories
  • Overnight option in air-conditioned dorms

Goalkeeper School

Goalkeeping is coached properly here, not squeezed into the last ten minutes of a field session.

The Goalkeeper School runs during Elite Camp, with dedicated instruction for keepers on technique and the demands of the position. Keepers choose how much of the week they spend in goal.

  • Full-time goalkeeper training for keepers who want it
  • Part-time keepers choose daily between the field session and the keeper session
  • Position-specific technical instruction

Two different arrival times, depending on which option you registered for.

Overnight campers

Sunday, 6:00–8:00 PM

Check in at the dorms. Bring bed linens and towels with you — see the packing list below.

A meal is not served on Sunday evening. Pizza orders are made available instead.

Day campers

Arrive ready to play. Field group assignment and instruction begin at 9:00 AM on Monday.

Day campers arrive ready to play at 9:00 AM every other morning too.

Team camp

High School Girls Team Camp

Train together. Compete together. Grow together.

Four days of preseason for your whole squad, on a college campus, with games every evening.

  • Dates July 12 – 15, 2026
  • Day camper $210
  • Overnight camper $375
Register your team Mountain Challenge

About team camp

This camp is built for high school girls soccer teams who want real preseason preparation: competitive games, proper training volume and time together away from the usual routine.

Teams register as a unit rather than as individual players, and train under the Maryville College coaching staff alongside their own coaches.

Each team receives

  • Two training sessions per day
  • Games every evening
  • A college-level coaching environment
  • Optional team-building experiences on campus

Optional add-on

Maryville College Mountain Challenge

Team-building activities led by Maryville College Mountain Challenge in the college’s award-winning campus woods.

High ropes

Elements up in the trees, with the whole squad belaying and encouraging.

Low ropes

Ground-level problem solving that needs the group to work as one.

Canoes

On the water together, off the field entirely.

$30 per player

Priced separately and not included in the camp fee. Your team chooses one activity.

Mountain Challenge is optional. Let camp staff know when you register if your team would like to take part.

More than soccer

Maryville sits about 25 minutes from downtown Knoxville and 25 minutes from Great Smoky Mountains National Park, which makes camp week an easy team trip as well as a preseason.

If your team would like to add a hike in the mountains or a trip to Gatlinburg around camp, camp staff are happy to help you plan it.
